hero.title: LET'S TALK
hero.subtitle: Need a website, chatbot or automation? Tell us the job.

faqData.a: Business websites, AI chatbots and assistants, WhatsApp and Telegram bots, and office automation — all with fixed quotes and human support.

faqData.q: How do we start working together?
faqData.a: Absolutely. Send your requirement through the quote form or email admin@dipc.site — we reply with next steps and a fixed price.

faqData.q: What is your typical tech stack for production?
faqData.a: Websites run on Next.js, React and Tailwind CSS. Chatbots use modern AI tooling with LangChain. Bots run on official WhatsApp and Telegram business APIs, with PostgreSQL databases and backups.

faqData.q: Do you have experience with enterprise or institutional projects?
faqData.a: Yes. Our web-store work for Krishi Sewa Foundation and the corporate site for Mathrubhumi Enterprises are recent examples of institutional delivery.

faqData.q: How can we start a partnership or project?
faqData.a: The most efficient way is to use the contact form above or reach out directly via email at admin@dipc.site. We usually reply within 24 hours with next steps and a fixed quote.
